fact: On 26 September 2025 the ministry stated e-Ardhi is used for planning, surveying, allocation, registration and valuation in Dodoma, Arusha, Tanga, Mbeya and Mwanza and several councils, nationwide for valuation and registration of legal documents, with public registration online.
title: Taarifa kwa umma: utoaji huduma za ardhi kupitia mfumo wa e-Ardhi
publisher: Wizara ya Ardhi, Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi
